item.tib: mkha' 'gro thugs kyi sgrub pa zag med rdo rje 'phreng ba'i gzhung
item.coloph: mkha' 'gro'i thugs sgrab zab mo 'di/ gsang spyod man ngag rin chen gter/ mkha' 'gros gnyer gtad thob par byas/ skal ldan grogs kyis bskul ba'i ngor/ phyi rabs 'gro la phan phyir du/ zab mo man ngag yi ger bkod/ nyes 'gal tshang par bzod pa gsol/ legs 'byung yon tan grogs la bsngo/ thams cad rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shog snyigs ma'i kho bo pad+ma rje'i/ (rjes) sing ha brag gi gnas su bkod pa dge legs su gyur cig/
